paraphrase: The eighteen schools fall into four groups: seven Sarvāstivāda (Mūlasarvāstivāda, Kāśyapīya, Mahīśāsaka, Dharmaguptaka, Bahuśrutīya, Tāmraśāṭīya, Vibhajyavāda), five Mahāsāṃghika (Pūrvaśaila, Aparaśaila, Haimavata, Lokottaravāda, Prajñaptivāda), three Saṃmitīya (Kaurukullaka, Āvantaka, Vātsīputrīya) and three Sthavira (Jetavanīya, Abhayagirivāsin, Mahāvihāravāsin).
notes: Reference from memory; not located in a local text. The four-group list as known in Tibetan scholarship; membership from memory.
